programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

programme.title: My Blind Brother
programme.desc: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize.

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her.

programme.title: Super Troopers 2
programme.desc: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear.

programme.title: Ocean's Eight
programme.desc: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams).

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody.

programme.title: Man Down
programme.desc: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.

programme.title: My Blind Brother
programme.desc: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize.

programme.title: Black Butterfly
programme.desc: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end.

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

programme.title: Our Kind of Traitor
programme.desc: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

programme.title: The Watchers
programme.desc: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
programme.desc: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region.

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: Working-class waitress Slim (Jennifer Lopez) finds her life transformed when she marries wealthy contractor Mitch (Billy Campbell). She settles into an idyllic suburban life and seems to have everything she wants. Her dream is shattered when she discovers her husband is anything but perfect. His abusive behavior forces her to go on the run, eluding an increasingly obsessive Mitch and his lethal henchman.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin
programme.desc: Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.title: Inside Man
programme.desc: A tough detective matches wits with a bank robber, while an enigmatic woman has her own agenda.

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own.

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin

programme.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
programme.desc: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.

programme.title: Morbius
programme.desc: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder and determined to save others from the same fate, Dr. Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. While at first it seems to be a radical success, a darkness inside of him is soon unleashed.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: After the death of her mother and having no other known relatives, Evie takes a DNA test and discovers a long-lost cousin she never knew she had. Invited by her newfound family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, Evie's at first seduced by the sexy aristocratic host. However, she's soon thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets about her family history and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity.

programme.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
programme.desc: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies.

programme.title: Squad Car
programme.desc: An accused man (Don Marlowe) helps a policeman (Paul Bryar) investigate an airplane mechanic's death and a counterfeit racket.

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Richard Hooker, M*A*S*H follows a group of Mobile Army Surgical Hospital officers at they perform surgery and pass the time just miles from the front lines of the Korean Conflict. Led by Captains Hawkeye Pierce (Donald Sutherland) and Trapper John McIntyre (Elliott Gould), they add to the chaos and hilarity of the situation.

programme.title: The Kremlin Letter
programme.desc: When an unauthorized letter is sent to Moscow alleging the U.S. government's willingness to help Russia attack China, former naval officer Charles Rone and his team are sent to retrieve it. They go undercover, successfully reaching out to Erika Kosnov, the wife of a former agent, now married to the head of Russia's secret police. Their plans are interrupted, however, when their Moscow hideout is raided by a cunning politician.

programme.title: The Horror of It All
programme.desc: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one.

programme.title: The Quiller Memorandum
programme.desc: After two British Secret Intelligence Service agents are murdered at the hands of a cryptic neo-Nazi group known as Phoenix, the suave agent Quiller is sent to Berlin to investigate. There, he begins an affair with Inge Lindt, a beautiful young teacher. However, their lives are put in danger after Quiller is kidnapped and taken to Phoenix's headquarters, where he meets Oktober, the mysterious leader of the group.

programme.title: The Gang's All Here
programme.desc: The night before his deployment in World War II, wealthy heir Andy Mason (James Ellison) falls in love with Eadie (Alice Faye), a beautiful cabaret singer. The two hit it off, but Mason fails to reveal the fact that he has already promised to marry Vivian (Sheila Ryan), a family friend. When he returns from the war a hero, his father throws a huge party for him, hiring Eadie and her company to perform. Mason hopes to find an out with Vivian in order to marry his true love.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
programme.desc: Welcome to Raccoon City, once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corp. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland, a dying town with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square.

programme.title: FXM Presents
programme.desc: An examination of the process of making movies follows a production from script to screen.

programme.title: Fantastic Voyage
programme.desc: The brilliant scientist Jan Benes develops a way to shrink humans, and other objects, for brief periods of time. Benes, who is working in communist Russia, is transported by the CIA to America, but is attacked en route. In order to save the scientist, who has developed a blood clot in his brain, a team of Americans in a nuclear submarine is shrunk and injected into Benes' body. They have a finite period of time to fix the clot and get out before the miniaturization wears off.

programme.title: The Day Mars Invaded Earth
programme.desc: A Cape Canaveral scientist finds Martians reducing people to ashes and taking their places.

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself.

programme.title: The Flight of the Phoenix
programme.desc: Tense tale about a group of men who are left stranded in the middle of the Arabian desert after a plane crash. Their only hope of survival is to rebuild the craft so that, phoenix-like, she may fly again and carry them to safety, but can the captain and navigator calm the passengers as tension mounts and time starts to run out?

programme.title: The Lion
programme.desc: Living an idyllic existence on a Kenyan wildlife preserve, Tina (Pamela Franklin) is remarkably at home with the resident animals. In fact, she is so comfortable with the various creatures that her best friend is an adult lion. While Tina isn't too worried by this relationship, her mother, Christine (Capucine), becomes extremely concerned, and requests that her ex-husband -- Tina's father, Robert (William Holden) -- come for a visit to help straighten the girl out.

programme.title: The Adventures of Hajji Baba
programme.desc: A clever Persian barber (John Derek) wows the harem and wins a princess (Elaine Stewart) by saving her from an evil prince.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: In the Mexican town of San Angel, Manolo (Diego Luna), Maria (Zoë Saldana) and Joaquin (Channing Tatum) have been friends ever since childhood. Although their lives have taken different paths -- Maria was sent to Europe, Joaquin joined the military, and Manolo studied to become a bullfighter -- one thing remains the same: Manolo and Joaquin both want to marry Maria. Little does the trio know that battling husband-and-wife deities have made a high-stakes wager on the love triangle's outcome.

programme.title: The Empty Man
programme.desc: A series of mysterious disappearances in a small Midwestern town may be linked to a supernatural entity.

programme.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
programme.desc: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller.

programme.title: Soup to Nuts
programme.desc: Two guys and a girl run into Mexican rebels and lots of fires.

programme.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
programme.desc: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder.

programme.title: The Black Rose
programme.desc: Following the 13th-century death of his nobleman father, Walter of Gurnie (Tyrone Power) and his confidant, Tristram (Jack Hawkins), join a caravan led by the North African Bayan (Orson Welles) en route to China. Along the way, the beautiful Maryam (Cecile Aubry), known as the Black Rose, begs Walter to take her to England with him. When the warlord Bayan reveals his intention to invade and subjugate China's advanced society, the trio attempt their escape back to England.

programme.title: All About Eve
programme.desc: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo.

programme.title: My Friend Flicka
programme.desc: Ken McLaughlin (Roddy McDowall) is a precocious 10-year-old who lives with his family on a remote Wyoming ranch. When Ken returns home from school with failing grades, his father, Rob (Preston Foster), blames the boy's lack of personal responsibility. At the suggestion of his wife, Nell (Rita Johnson), Rob allows Ken to choose a single colt from the herd to raise as his own. Much to his father's dismay, Ken chooses a fiery mustang filly -- but the two soon become fast friends.

programme.title: Curly Top
programme.desc: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary.

programme.title: A Journal for Jordan
programme.desc: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family.

programme.title: West Side Story
programme.desc: Love at first sight strikes when young Tony spots Maria at a high school dance in 1957 New York City. Their burgeoning romance helps to fuel the fire between the warring Jets and Sharks -- two rival gangs vying for control of the streets.

programme.desc: In ancient Egypt, Sinuhe (Edmund Purdom) is a would-be doctor who saves the life of a young man (Michael Wilding) suffering from a seizure. When the afflicted youth awakes, he introduces himself as the Pharaoh Akhnaton and makes Sinuhe the royal healer. While working at his new, prestigious post, Sinuhe suffers through a botched romance and the death of his adoptive parents. Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton.

programme.title: Cleopatra
programme.desc: "Cleopatra" is a lengthy, sprawling, spectacular love story, helmed by Joseph L. Mankiewicz, depicting Cleopatra's manipulation of Julius Caesar and Marc Antony in her ill-fated attempt to save the Egyptian empire. This threesome in one of the most famous and gloriously powerful love triangles ever to be captured on film.

programme.title: Tolkien
programme.desc: As a young student, J.R.R. Tolkien finds love, friendship and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts. Their brotherhood soon strengthens as Tolkien weathers the storm of a tumultuous courtship with Edith Bratt and the outbreak of World War I. These early life experiences later inspire the budding author to write the classic fantasy novels The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

programme.title: Freud's Last Session
programme.desc: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands.

programme.title: Freud's Last Session
programme.desc: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind.

programme.title: Tolkien
programme.desc: As a young student, J.R.R. Tolkien finds love, friendship and artistic inspiration among a group of fellow outcasts. Their brotherhood soon strengthens as Tolkien weathers the storm of a tumultuous courtship with Edith Bratt and the outbreak of World War I. These early life experiences later inspire the budding author to write the classic fantasy novels The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

programme.title: The Song of Bernadette
programme.desc: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status.

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
programme.desc: Defying her conventional in-laws, young widow Lucy Muir (Gene Tierney) leaves London with her young daughter and moves away for a quieter life in a secluded seaside cottage. Lucy discovers the ghost of the deceased former owner, sea captain Daniel Gregg (Rex Harrison), is haunting the house, but gathers the courage to stand up to him, and woman and ghost become friends. Faced with dwindling means of support, Lucy agrees to the Captain's challenge to write his colorful life story.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley
programme.desc: Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel.

programme.title: The Innocents
programme.desc: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers.

programme.title: Witchcraft
programme.desc: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected.

programme.title: Hush... Hush, Sweet Charlotte
programme.desc: Forty years ago, on the night they were meant to elope, Charlotte Hollis (Bette Davis) found her lover decapitated during a party, the blood on her dress leading everyone to suspect she was the murderer. Now, in 1964, Charlotte is an old recluse and must fight to keep her home. She enlists the help of her cousin Velma (Olivia de Havilland), who was there at the time of the murder. However, soon after Velma's arrival, Charlotte's mind becomes unstable, and she starts seeing her dead lover's head.

programme.title: Mothering Sunday
programme.desc: With her employers away, a housemaid sneaks off to spend quality time with her secret lover -- a man who's engaged to another woman.

programme.title: Ready or Not
programme.desc: Grace couldn't be happier after she marries the man of her dreams at his family's luxurious estate. There's just one catch -- she must now hide from midnight until dawn while her new in-laws hunt her down with guns, crossbows and other weapons. As Grace desperately tries to survive the night, she soon finds a way to turn the tables on her not-so-lovable relatives.

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Escaping postwar Europe, a visionary architect comes to America to rebuild his life, his career, and his marriage. On his own in a strange new country, he settles in Pennsylvania, where a wealthy and prominent industrialist recognises his talent.

programme.title: Tow
programme.desc: The true story of Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman who fought her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a tow bill for $21,634.

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's flamboyant treatment of the Who's rock opera about a deaf, dumb and blind boy who develops an extraordinary ability at pinball. Under his sinister stepfather's influence, he achieves fame and a cult following, but his almost messianic status also spells the beginning of his destruction.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Hidden secrets and long-buried resentments come to light when two estranged brothers reunite at a primitive cabin deep in the woods of Northern England.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now administers. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a Jewish boy on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

programme.title: Tow
programme.desc: The true story of Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman who fought her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a tow bill for $21,634.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

programme.title: Catch Me if You Can
programme.desc: Based on a true-crime story about teenage con man Frank Abagnale Jr, who cashed fake cheques worth over $2.5 million while disguised as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, all the while chased by an FBI agent who is determined to catch him.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Coach Ken Carter, a controversial high school basketball coach who received national attention when he benched his undefeated team due to their collective poor academic record in 1999. In the face of much criticism, Carter fought to keep his methods, determined to show the boys that they need to rely on more than sports for their futures.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

programme.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
programme.desc: A bittersweet story about a 43-year-old woman on the verge of divorce who magically travels back in time to her senior high-school years. She is able to act with the benefit of hindsight, but despite her efforts, she falls for the same boy all over again.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million worth of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.

programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. An American mercenary who knows of the secret location is rescued from a Cairo prison by an English historian and her brother, and together they set off on a hunt. Along the way, the trio encounter flesh-eating scarab beetles, killer sandstorms, and reincarnated demons.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.title: Jaws III
programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.title: The Bank Job

programme.desc: When a string of brutal murders terrorises London, it does not take long for legendary detective Sherlock Holmes and his crime-solving partner, Dr Watson, to find the killer, Lord Blackwood. A devotee of the dark arts, Blackwood has a bigger scheme in mind, and his execution plays right into his plans. The game is afoot when Blackwood seems to rise from the grave, plunging Holmes and Watson into the world of the occult and strange technologies.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows

programme.desc: Film producer Robert Evans narrates this documentary chronicling the ups and downs of his extraordinary life. Among the topics covered are his big break into the movie industry, his failed marriage to Ali McGraw, his relationships with Grace Kelly and Ava Gardner, his descent into drug addiction, and his journey back to respectability. With contributions by friends and family, and including footage of a host of Hollywood legends.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of American director and screenwriter Spike Lee, whose films include Do the Right Thing, Malcolm X, Summer of Sam and BlacKkKlansman.

programme.title: Discovering: Alain Delon
programme.desc: A profile of the French actor, who worked with directors including Luchino Visconti, Jean-Luc Godard, Jean-Pierre Melville, Michelangelo Antonioni and Louis Malle.

programme.title: Lost Grounds
programme.desc: Fat Boy Slim reveals what he likes most about Brighton's old stadiums. Plus, visits to the Dell and the Den, and a visit to an abandoned amusement arcade in Southend.

programme.title: I Am Steve McQueen
programme.desc: The life and career of the American actor, who starred in The Thomas Crown Affair, The Getaway, Papillon, The Magnificent Seven, The Great Escape and The Towering Inferno. Featuring contributions by his son Chad, grandson Steven and granddaughter Molly, as well as ex-wives Neile Adams McQueen and Ali MacGraw and widow Barbara Minty McQueen.

programme.title: Salt Path: A Very British Scandal
programme.desc: A look at Observer journalist Chloe Hadjimatheou's investigation into allegations of factual inaccuracies in Raynor Winn's book The Salt Path.

programme.title: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
programme.desc: A look at the nerve agent attack on former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in Salisbury, with contributions from intelligence and counterterrorism officials, journalists and victims. The film uncovers how authorities raced to identify the perpetrators, contain a deadly chemical weapon and respond to one of the most brazen acts of state-sponsored aggression on British soil.

programme.title: The Thin Blue Line
programme.desc: Film-maker Errol Morris's documentary presenting a reconstructive study that succeeded in proving the innocence of a man being held on death row following his conviction of the murder of a Dallas policeman in 1976.

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: As water flows from Australia's highlands into the seas, environmental changes set the stage for unexpected clashes between predators and their prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Leading shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a TV first as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white shark off Guadalupe Island.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: The animals that live on the border between the US and Canada face many challenges - even politics. This documentary reveals how the boundary affects them over 12 months.

programme.title: Uptown Otters
programme.desc: Following families of otters in Singapore, beginning with the Bay clan's lush territory, where matriarch Anna offers lavish feasts, but faces internal dissent.

programme.title: Uptown Otters
programme.desc: Anna spends quality time with the young pups, then visit a flooded mangrove before checking in on the Townies, whose resources are thinning.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Stu and Liv catch a pregnant red-bellied black snake at a busy resort, while Mick and Adele face a lace monitor lizard.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Stu and Liv outwit a blue tongue lizard, Jess and Dan free a trapped snake, and Mick and Adele rush a python rescue fast.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Aggressive behaviour is not limited to the most obvious culprits. Revealing how koalas, cockatoos, clownfish and more can exhibit surprising behaviours in order to survive.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: How animals employ extravagant behaviours to entice mates or warn off predators, proving that standing out can be the ultimate survival strategy.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: The search begins for a Cooper's hawk who's taken a dangerous dip in a backyard pool. Plus, the centre's skunks try to avoid getting their shots.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: When a baby mink is abandoned in a store, the team gets to work on some behavioural training. But will this sweet little one be tough enough for the wild when they're done?

programme.title: Nature's Dress Code: Who Wears What and Why?
programme.desc: Every living creature, from the amoeba to the blue whale, needs a suitable coat. Dive deep into the fashion styles of the natural world with this colourful documentary.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli
programme.desc: Documentary about a group of elusive chimpanzees living in the Fongoli region of Senegal, on the southern edge of the Sahara Desert. It's the hottest, driest place in the world that chimps can live and they really shouldn't be here - so how do they survive?

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist and film-maker explores the many varieties of plant life housed at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, and explains what they reveal about the natural world and the development of life on Earth. He begins inside the establishment's Palm House, whose climate has been engineered to simulate conditions found in rainforests, charting the evolution of plants that grow in the world's wettest regions and investigating how flowering plants spread across the globe so rapidly.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist explores how the plants at Kew Gardens change through the seasons and demonstrates the surprising properties of several species, including the predatory pond-dwelling bladderwort utricularia and a fungus that appears to be capable of mind control. He also discusses the largest single organism on the planet, visits the world's biggest flower and explains how plants and insects can communicate using scents and music.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his exploration of the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, by examining plants that have evolved to minimise their dependence on water, enabling them to survive in the world's driest environments. He witnesses a cactus blooming at midnight, tells the story of the spectacular flowering of the Agave franzosinii, and visits the Millennium Seed Bank, a facility designed to save plants from future extinction.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programme.desc: A journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives and transforms, while witnessing the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle and walking tall with flamingos.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Scientists discover animals with the power to restore our grasslands, turning them into carbon sinks that could slow climate change.

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: The lionesses from the Hollywood pride are in grave trouble, with intruders occupying their prime hunting grounds and the four dangerous Nomad lions blocking their path home.

programme.title: Big Cat Country
programme.desc: The MK pride faces its toughest moment yet as their matriarch and best hunter Surabi's life hangs in the balance after being gored by a buffalo.

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Cameras journey with nature's nomads and hitchhikers, from monarch butterflies on an epic migration to the hidden world within a sloth's fur.

programme.title: Big Cats, Nine Lives
programme.desc: Following a tiger from tiny cub to formidable hunter, as instinct and stealth guide it through a solitary world of shifting territories, fierce rivalry and ever-present danger.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Dragons and Damsels
programme.desc: Arguably more beautiful than butterflies, better fliers than hummingbirds and with intriguing and complex behavioural patterns - dragonflies and damselflies are marvels of the insect kingdom. This documentary uses the latest camera technology to show their manoeuvres, mating strategies, territorial behaviour and flight dynamics, revealing them to be the ultimate insect.

programme.title: Jellyfish: The Ocean's New Rulers
programme.desc: Investigating the growing population of jellyfish blooms around the world and examining whether this species is on its way to dominating the oceans as they once did.

programme.title: David Attenborough Meets Obama
programme.desc: Another chance to see Barack Obama's conversation, recorded in May 2015, with renowned naturalist and film-maker David Attenborough. In a twist on usual convention, the then-US president took the role of interviewer, quizzing Attenborough about his thoughts on the future of the planet, their shared passion for nature, and potential ways to protect the environment. Also includes behind-the-scenes footage from Sir David's latest project on the Great Barrier Reef, as well as highlights from throughout the veteran broadcaster's career.

programme.desc: The sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls and fairy prions on New Zealand's Otago Peninsula find mates and nurture the next generation.

programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 206
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.desc: Every year seven million people die from air pollution. It's the world's biggest environmental killer.

programme.desc: In South Africa and Nepal, earthrise looks at food production solutions being developed to help with adjusting to new conditions.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Tank"
programme.desc: Stacey battles to save a severely injured hunting dog, Millie the calf has been mauled by a dog and the Mark and Stacey work together to change the gender of a cat.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "UFO"
programme.desc: Meg the Labrador has swallowed a UFO, Chocolate the horse is suffering from asthma and Mark and Stacey compete in a chilli eating challenge.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Boss"
programme.desc: Boss the dog has a nasty injury from a possum trap, the fire brigade are called to save a cat stuck up a tree and Mark and Stacey compete in a fireman’s challenge.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Darting"
programme.desc: Stacey discovers Marama the poodle has breast cancer, Mark tries to save a herd of pregnant cows from miscarrying and the Vet North team dart calves amongst the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Molly"
programme.desc: Molly the dog is paralysed in a hit and run accident, Mark is having a busy day with pigs, goats, horses and a mauled cow and Stacey treats a tortoise with a sore leg.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Bear"
programme.desc: Bear the Labrador has come into see Stacey again for a sore knee. Stacey travels up to Auckland to assist Mark with a calf that’s stuck in the birth cannel.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Cuban"
programme.desc: Bear the labrador has a sore leg, which turns into a really expensive problem and Mark travels down to Rotorua to help Stacey with a busy day on the farm.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Sushi"
programme.desc: Mark tries to save a girl’s pet lamb, Stacey treats Max who has bad arthritis and both Mark and Stacey volunteer for the day at SPCA.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Robbie"
programme.desc: Howdie and Dawn are working dogs and their owner wants them to mate, but neither are interested so Stacey intervenes, Mark treats a horse with a very sore leg and Stacey operates on sushi the cat who has skin cancer.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Willow"
programme.desc: Willow’s leg is lame and Stacey decides to amputate, Jack the Jack Russel has been kicked out of doggy school and Stacey tries to help and Mark changes Shadow the cat from a male into a female.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sight"
programme.desc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. People with good vision are sometimes called "eagle eyed", but eagles can see a fish from many dozen metres away.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Hearing"
programme.desc: On this episode we travel from the desert, to the forest, Australia to Borneo and back to learn how species as diverse as Bat-eared Foxes, the Bilby, Deer, Kangaroo Rats, cicadas, Proboscis Monkeys and other creatures never miss an auditory trick.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Touch"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we get in touch with the feelings of wild animals. Really in touch. Because animals, just like humans, rely heavily on their sense of touch, every day in every way.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Taste and Smell"
programme.desc: On this episode of Animal Super Senses, we examine how things taste, and how vital scent is from the animal perspective. But their sense of smell will also detect the scent of odorants carried through the air.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Superhuman Senses"
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sixth Sense"
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by. There’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sense of Timing"
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine how every animal has what could be called a sense of rhythm – the human animal included. To give an obvious example, there’s our internal body clock which responds to the so-called Circadian rhythm.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programme.desc: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground….

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Night"
programme.desc: We find out about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive. Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason. You need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"
programme.desc: We find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground. And find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Communication"
programme.desc: Animals use communication to attract mates,warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey. And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"
programme.desc: In this last episode of Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do.

programme.title: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Concrete to Clay"
programme.desc: Innovators reimagine building materials using textile-reinforced concrete, ancient Roman techniques, and 3D-printed clay structures.

programme.title: Miracle Materials S1 - "From Wood to Bamboo"
programme.desc: Architects harness rapidly renewable resources like timber, transparent wood, bamboo, and mycelium fungi to construct future cities.

programme.title: Miracle Materials S1 - "Living Bridges And Fiber Constructions"
programme.desc: Hybrid architecture integrates living trees and resource-efficient fiber designs to cool urban centers and transform modern building.

programme.title: Steel Monsters S1 - "Mega Towing"

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Baklava/Gyroplane/Ukulele"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Longboards/Lemonade/Forklifts"
programme.desc: How do they carve longboards, the skateboard’s bigger, faster brother? How do they turn tonnes of lemons into millions of bottles of lemons? How do they build industry’s versatile heavy lifter, the forklift truck?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Coffee/Bricks/Lavalamps/Diamonds"
programme.desc: How do they roast the coffee that wakes up Italy? How do they bake the bricks that build America? How do they heat the oil that fills lava lamps? How do they blast diamonds from a frozen volcano?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Cameras/Big Airbags/ Jelly Beans"
programme.desc: How do they take the world’s sharpest photos? How do they stitch an airbag that can catch a falling car? How do they make billions of perfect jelly beans?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Caravans/Tuning Forks/Ice Resurfacer/Festival of Lights"
programme.desc: How do they build a caravan that’s tougher than an SUV? How do they forge tuning forks to provide musicians with perfect pitch? How do they resurface an ice rink in minutes? How do they put on the world’s biggest festival of lights?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Vinyl Records/Bumper Cars/Tiger Balm"
programme.desc: How do they make the world’s grooviest music, the vinyl LP? How do they build the world’s most crashed car, the dodgem? How do they create one of the world’s oldest pain remedies, tiger balm?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Alcohol Free Beer/Tomcars/Escalators/Lie Detectors"
programme.desc: How do they brew a beer that won’t make you drunk? How do they build a car that flies over rocks and boulders? How do they bolt together an escalator that will carry millions every year? How do they bust criminals with a lie detector?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Axes/Messenger Bags/Fast Rescue Boats"
programme.desc: How do they forge one of the greatest inventions of all time, the axe? How do they cut, sew, stitch and glue together a courier’s messenger bag? How do they build the world’s fastest lifeboats?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Wensleydale Cheese/Paintbrushes/Eucalyptus Oil/Plastic Wrap"
programme.desc: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Surviving Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits NASA’s Swamp Works, which tests space suits and machines for Mars-like conditions.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Engineering Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits four types of engineers who are on the cutting edge of aerospace technology.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Satellite’s Eye View"
programme.desc: Join host Emily Calandrelli as we look at satellites that will provide us with instant images of our planet and bring high-speed internet to every human on Earth.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "The Art of Space"

All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

Raeleen celebrates women in aviation at the most female friendly airport in the world.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S2 - "Terry's Underworld"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry are going to test a famous scene from Underworld with Kate Beckensale. Terry will attempt to shoot a circle around himself in the floor and fall through to save himself from the pack of werewolves.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Terry Loves 70's Cop Shows"

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Helping Hands"
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive with dozens of bull sharks in Fiji. We then head to South Florida to plant native mangroves in an area of need. The journey ends with a trip to Maui.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Formations"
programme.desc: In this episode, Cousteau explores some of our planets most incredible natural formations.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Sports & The Environment"
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to the intersection of sports and our environment.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Student Explorer"
programme.desc: In this episode, we reveal the winner of our second ever #StudentExplorer Contest.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Dennis Hong"

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Don Shaw"

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Lucas Toledo"

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Tabb Firchau"

programme.title: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Wonder of Bridges"
programme.desc: Pre-industrial societies around the world construct early bridges, reflecting evolving technologies and expanding human exploration.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Modern Day Killer Asteroid"

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Fixing A Broken Heart"
programme.desc: Heart disease is the number one cause of death worldwide, but there are researchers frantically working to change that.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "T-Rex Timeline"

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Resurrecting Tasmanian Tigers"
programme.desc: Wiped off the face of the Earth by humans nearly a century ago, geneticists are now working on ressurecting the enigmatic Tasmanian Tiger.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "George Aldrich"
programme.desc: Thom meets a man with a superhuman sense of smell; George Aldrich is Nasa’s Chief Sniffer; employed to detect problems before they become a hazard in space.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Kenya"

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "By Camel to Timbuktu"

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Indian Monsoon"

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Java - Land of Fire"
programme.desc: The most notorious volcanic explosion in history came from the small island of Krakatoa, off the coast of Java. The tiny island was pulverized and the giant explosion was felt half way around the world. Java is at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Tank"
programme.desc: Hand powered tank, is that possible? Leonardo Da Vinci thought so. Today we will test this theory.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programme.sub-title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programme.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
programme.desc: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
programme.sub-title: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programme.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programme.sub-title: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programme.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programme.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Fuel for Destruction"
programme.desc: The atomic age introduces powerful rockets and nuclear energy, balancing technological advancement with threats like the Chernobyl disaster.

programme.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Golden Age of Science"
programme.desc: Military funding drives a boom in earth sciences and biological research, creating advanced weapons alongside deeper insights into our world.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "US Aviation"

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Occupied Territories"

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "US Ships"

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Stealth Submarines"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Shelter"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Land Gaining Ground"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Survival"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Antarctica On The Edge"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Coping With Extremes"

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Space Bots"

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Man Made Disasters"

programme.desc: Architects harness rapidly renewable resources like timber, transparent wood, bamboo, and mycelium fungi to construct future cities.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special

programme.sub-title: FishON - Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! - Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Discovering Russia
programme.desc: The Russia Beyond team set themselves a tough challenge — to experience and document unique adventures in Russia. The team visits the birthplace of 29-time UFC champion Khabib Nurmagomedov in Dagestan and climbs Elbrus, Europe's highest peak. From the cold of Yakutia to sunny Crimean vineyards, they explore many scenic landmarks as part of their Russia: 85 Adventures project.

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

programme.title: Outer Space
programme.desc: Kids all over the world say they want to become cosmonauts when they grow up. Irina, Konstantin and Andrey shoot for the stars in the latest recruitment campaign run by Russia's state space agency, Roscosmos. These people have diverse backgrounds: Irina is a medical doctor specialising in sport. Konstantin works as a business consultant. Andrey, the aeronautic engineer, is a family man, who devotes almost all of his spare time to physical training and studying math. Will they succeed in this ambitious endeavor?

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

programme.title: Outer Space
programme.desc: Kids all over the world say they want to become cosmonauts when they grow up. Irina, Konstantin and Andrey shoot for the stars in the latest recruitment campaign run by Russia's state space agency, Roscosmos. These people have diverse backgrounds: Irina is a medical doctor specialising in sport. Konstantin works as a business consultant. Andrey, the aeronautic engineer, is a family man, who devotes almost all of his spare time to physical training and studying math. Will they succeed in this ambitious endeavor?

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.
